title: Personal Data Exit Map
user: People leaving a service or preparing for lockout who need a sober inventory of their export, what can be reused elsewhere, and what account-dependent data will remain behind.
smallest_useful_product: A local web app that opens supported export archives, creates a file/metadata inventory, detects common reusable formats, produces a preservation checklist and a signed manifest, and links to manual export steps for unsupported services.
success_measure: 75% of test users can answer where their top five data categories are stored and complete one verified export within a single session.
constraints: Never ask for account passwords or upload exports.
Label formats and version support precisely.
Do not imply an export preserves legal access rights or social relationships.
